Cookie Info & Loading
Hm... What magic glyph should I draw today? Oops! I'm tardy! And I'm the professor!
Did someone say "latte"? When I was a student, lattes were only served warm!
Sometimes, there's no correct answer. Everyone starts off as a beginner!
Interested in learning about Latte Magic? Oh gosh! I'm late for class!
Keep your cool and be confident! Promise? Sooner or later, you'll find the answer you need.
Tired

Lobby

Daily Reward
Here you go! A gift from your favorite professor!
Tap
Whenever you need an ear, my office door is always open! Relax! Here, have a latte.
Do you like lattes too? Being a student means wanting to learn!
I'm too laid back? Haha, I've heard that too often when I was first researching coffee magic. Writing a thesis was fun! But I'm not eager to write another!
You got this! I'm sure your studies will take you far and wide! Coffee magic isn't easy. But I never gave up!
If you're having a rough time, don't hesitate to ask for help! I can't believe I'm a professor. It feels so weird!
Conditional

When placed in a Lobby with Melon Soda Cookie or  Watermelon PUNCH! I can always count on you!
When placed in a Lobby with Strawberry Crepe Cookie or  Endless Summer Fun Oh! I've heard so much about you from a certain nitpicky colleague of mine!
Gift
Neutral Hm... This really isn't my style.

 Sunset Vacation

Reused quotes are marked with an asterisk.

General

Cookie Info & Loading
Oh gosh! I'm late for class! Wait... I'm on vacation! No rush, no worries about being tardy... Now THIS is a vacation!
I have a vacation rule! Lattes are only served with ice, haha! Keep your cool and be confident! Promise?*
I keep thinking about my students... I guess I really am a teacher at heart! So you want to try Latte Magic? We can practice drawing magic circles in the sand!
The sunset is SO beautiful and you want me to hurry? Come on now, really? It's important to stop and rest before moving forward!
Everyone finds their own pace in their own time! Well-rested teachers make the best teachers, don't you think?
Tired
Ahh... This vacation can't be over already...

Lobby

Daily Reward
I'm so glad I ran into you! This has been a truly wonderful vacation!
Tap
Oh, perfect timing! The sun is starting to set. A latte with a spoonful of sunset! Not that's a perfect pairing.
Knowing how to enjoy a little rest takes talent too. I wish my students could see this... This sunset is too beautiful to enjoy alone!
The waves taught me something. No matter what happens, it just comes rolling back in! Oh my! I never expected to run into you here! Small world, isn't it?
The sea stretches as far as the eye can see! It's like the sea meets the sky! I only closed my eyes for a bit under the parsol,(sic) but the sun is already setting...!
Doing nothing and somehow gaining everything... Is this the magic of vacation? I'm recommending this beach for our next field trip!
Conditional
(These quotes require certain conditions to be met in order to trigger it in your Lobby)
When placed in the Order Up! Cafe Fruit Bomber Lobby After this vacation, I think my classes are going to be so much fun! I'm bursting with inspiration!
When placed in the A Fantastic Summer Getaway Lobby The way sunlight sparkles on the water... Maybe nature is the greatest magic of all?
When placed in a Lobby with  Watermelon PUNCH! Working hard, I see? Good! Just go at your own pace. Oh, and can I get a cup too?
When placed in a Lobby with  Sunburnt Surfer Someone was surfing earlier! They made it look so easy. I still think magic's easier than surfing though!
Gift
Neutral Oh my! Is this for me? I'll treasure it as a keepsake!
Given Well-Loved Steam Pitcher I wonder if I could create a latte spell to capture this moment forever...?
Given Royal Golden Dough Wow! This sparkles even brighter than the sand on the beach!
